candidate_contract.sparse_primary_bundle: bounded arity-3 tuples of distinct activated semantic edges; a semantic construction object, not a true evidence group or observed co-access event
candidate_contract.candidate_pool: protected ANN seeds union unique members of retained sparse semantic bundles
candidate_contract.nested_budgets: one selection order per method; S8 subset S16 subset S32

pairwise_factor_graph.training_supervision: outer-train valid distinct-member bundles projected to unordered member pairs only
pairwise_factor_graph.inference: same sparse candidate pool and protected ANN seeds as hypergraph; greedy selection on learned nonnegative unary plus pairwise factors

oracle.gold_coverage: outer-train OOF headroom only; not deployable; reports protected-seed residual groups, B=8/16/32 coverage, and budget infeasibility
oracle.learned_utility_exact: exact solve on a frozen small candidate pool; no gold evidence input; report greedy score, exact score, regret, normalized regret

system_evaluation.fixed_byte: same actual UTF-8 payload-byte cap per query and comparator
system_evaluation.iso_quality: minimum candidates, bytes, logical Tiles, and latency for matched group coverage
system_evaluation.iso_cost: coverage at matched candidate, bytes, logical Tiles, and latency cost

logical_tile.claim_boundary: logical Tile access locality only; not PIM hardware or PIM latency

statistics.multiplicity: Holm across preregistered primary Gate C contrasts; BH for explicitly secondary ablations
